scope: Resolved Maven runtime dependencies; excludes undisclosed issues, application logic and container images. Raw findings remain visible even when reviewed.

findings.summary: Spring Framework Server Sent Event stream corruption while rendering fragments

assessment.reason: No Server-Sent Event endpoints and no view fragments. APIs return JSON and pages use explicit static forwards. Checked by ProductionConfigurationTest.

findings.summary: Spring Framework Improper Path Limitation in XsltView

assessment.reason: No XsltViewResolver, no XSLT templates and no implicit wildcard view rendering. PageController returns explicit forward/redirect names. Checked by ProductionConfigurationTest.
